description.zh: 清理中文文章中的套话、重复和模板化表达，保留原意与作者语气。
description.en: Polish Chinese articles by removing filler, repetition, and formulaic phrasing while preserving meaning and voice.

description.zh: 通过补充背景、梳理结构和逐节修改，协作完成方案、说明和技术文档。
description.en: Develop proposals, guides, and technical documents through context gathering, structured drafting, and revision.

description.zh: 读取、编辑、合并、拆分和创建 PDF，支持表单填写、OCR 与页面预览；需桌面运行环境。
description.en: Read, edit, merge, split, and create PDFs, with form filling, OCR, and page previews. Requires a desktop runtime environment.

description.zh: 创建、读取和编辑 Word 文档，处理批注与修订，并转换为 PDF 检查版式；需桌面运行环境。
description.en: Create, read, and edit Word documents, work with comments and tracked changes, and convert to PDF for layout review. Requires a desktop runtime environment.

description.zh: 把笔记、转录稿和研究素材整理成文章，完善提纲、论据与段落节奏，并参考示例保持作者语气。
description.en: Turn notes, transcripts, and research into articles with clear outlines, grounded evidence, and a consistent author voice.

description.zh: 整理邮件、工作汇报和会议沟通，按读者背景调整结构、重点与表达。
description.en: Structure emails, status updates, and meeting communications for the audience, with clear purpose and next steps.

description.zh: 分析已有会议转写中的表达、提问和倾听方式，结合原文提出沟通改进建议。
description.en: Review communication, questioning, and listening patterns in existing meeting transcripts, with examples and improvement suggestions.

description.zh: 根据目标读者和产品资料撰写产品介绍、页面标题与行动文案，突出具体价值。
description.en: Write product descriptions, page headlines, and calls to action based on audience needs and product context.
